name: hero-heatmap
blurb: Hero with colorful heatmap shader visualization and tech badges.
description: Responsive hero with heading, description, CTA, and tech stack badges. Animated Heatmap shader over an icon image (cult-icon.svg) on desktop (1280×720) and mobile, with colorful spectrum (blue to magenta).
use_when: AI/SDK product with data-visualization aesthetic; icon-based heatmap creates technical, analytical feel.
avoid_when: Shader-intensive WebGL. Requires sized parent and /cult-icon.svg asset.
a11y: Screen-reader title (srTitle). Buttons and links focusable. Shader is decorative.
